verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform overview lists "Generate payroll reports" as an Embedded Payroll capability. Payroll records can also be retrieved through GET /v1/companies/{company_uuid}/payrolls, which offers a raw data path for analysis. Beyond that, the evidence gives only a single thin mention of reporting. Missing for 10: documented payroll register reports, gross-to-net breakdown reports, export formats (CSV/XLSX), an ops-facing report UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
